Certainly! Here's a draft of a concise professional follow-up email:

---

Subject: Request for Overdue Pricing Explanation

Dear [Vendor’s Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I wanted to follow up on the pricing information we discussed last week. It has been several days since your initial response, and I am still awaiting further details. Could you please provide an explanation or update regarding the pricing? Any additional information would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

[Your Full Name]  
[Your Position]  
[Company Name]  
[Contact Information]

---

Feel free to adjust any details as needed!
